claim: Between the control laser unit and the optical unit the beam travels in an optical fibre inside a flexible stainless-steel tube, inside a non-removable stainless-steel umbilical, which the manufacturer describes as protection against damage to the fibre and against any leak of laser light.
validity_conditions: Read from Tweez 305/310 Laser Safety Manual V3.0, November 2022, as installed in C:/Program Files/Aresis/Tweez300/Manuals/ (sha256 264ab54b...): printed page 3 (PDF page 5). E3 vendor_spec: the manufacturer's statement, not an observation on this bench. KNOWLEDGE, NOT POLICY: this is what the manufacturer says. What any session may do, and every limit anyone here acts on, is the person's, written into the envelope after confirming it on the instrument.
